messages:
maya: Heads-up — running a staged evacuation playbook for eu-west-1 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need agreement on tenant quarantine ordering and how we treat active-active sessions for pinned tenants.

ajay: +1. Is this the same ordering we used in the canary last month? I remember a debate about quarantining PII-bound tenants first. :thinking_face: 

riley: We split by residency strictness last time: strict juridical tenants -> opt-in consents -> default. Worked but caused a huge prewarm spike because we routed too many writes to fallback region.

maya: Correct. Proposal: 1) cordon region, drain non-resident stateless traffic, 2) start tenant-level quarantine for residency-strict (EU-only) tenants, 3) promote standby proxies for remaining tenants, 4) gradual write-forwarding for permissive tenants. Thoughts?

liam: Concern: step 2 (tenant quarantine) requires control-plane ops to set residency flags + KV-ownership toggles. That needs an API call per-tenant if done naively. Could we batch by tenant-tag?

sofia: We have tenant tags for residency-level already. We can drive quarantine by tag set. But the tricky bit: in active-active some tenants have live sessions in both regions. If we quarantine and route writes away we must reconcile any in-flight KV caches.

riley: Reconciliation costs are the big unknown. If we mark tenant quarantined we should also increment an eviction generation so proxies reject stale KVs and force rehydration on first request. Adds a small latency hit but simplifies correctness.

maya: Good call. Proposed implementation detail: set tenant.quarantine=true and tenant.eviction_gen +=1 atomically. Operator flow: 
```
# pseudo-ops
for tag in residency-strict:
  set_tag_quarantine(tag, true)
  bump_eviction_gen_for_tag(tag)
  notify-edge-proxies(tag)
```

ajay: How do we notify proxies? We rely on control-plane pubsub at scale. Need to ensure proxies see the generation bump before we flip routing rules. Otherwise writes can slip through.

sofia: We can publish a control-plane checkpoint event and wait for an ack window (2m?) from a subset of proxies (all active in the region). If ack < 90% then pause and escalate.

liam: Two operational knobs: ack_window and ack_threshold. Default 2m / 90% seems fine. We should document failure modes.

riley: Also consider fallback model variants: if target region lacks the full model (quantized variant), do we permit temporary downgrade for permissive tenants? That's business decision.

maya: Product already signed off on downgrades for permissive tenants under capacity pressure, but not for residency-strict. So our evacuation ordering must ensure residency-strict tenants never get downgraded.

ajay: Question: when we quarantine tenants, do we also throttle their batch sizes to reduce KV-coherence churn? Might help with reconcilers.

sofia: Throttling is doable via route-level rate limits. We can attach a temporary quota policy on quarantined tags that reduces throughput to X% for Y minutes.

liam: Need to be careful with SLAs. Quarantine+throttle combo should be an opt-in emergency action (enterprise only) or behind agreed SLO degradations. Add a banner in console and create rollbacks.

maya: Adding to runbook: preflight checks (capacity profile in target region, model parity, proxy ack rate), then execute quarantine tags in batches of ~100 tenants, wait for checkpoint ack, then flip route priorities.

riley: Batching size note: 100 tenants per batch was observed to keep kv-ops under 80% utilization in prior sim. We should include a small randomized delay between batches to smooth spike.

deploy-bot: deploy started: control-plane/quarantine-controller v2.3 -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

maya: Nice. Once v2.3 rolls to prod we can exercise this flow in a low-risk run tomorrow. Who owns post-run measurements (cache miss rate, recon rate, cost delta)?

sofia: I'll own metrics collection. Will instrument: eviction_gen bumps, proxy ack latencies, cold-start rate, and per-tenant cost shift.

liam: I'll prepare operator checklist and rollback commands. Eg: 
```
# rollback snippet
for tag in quarantined_tags:
  set_tag_quarantine(tag, false)
  notify-edge-proxies(tag)
```

ajay: One more thought: legal/consent tenants might require an audit trail for every quarantine action — include request IDs and signed operator id in events.

maya: Agreed. Control-plane will log operator id + reason + run id. add to runbook.

oncall-bot: Incident simulation scheduled: staged-evac-2026-03-23-03:00 UTC. Reminder in 18h.

riley: Ok — final ask: update the architecture doc with a clear diagram showing the handshake between control-plane quarantine events, proxy ack, and routing-flip. Otherwise new team members will miss the generation bump requirement.

maya: I'll create a short PR with the diagram and link it here. Thanks all — sync at 14:00 today to run through checklist. :thumbsup:
